scripts.build: corepack pnpm install --config.verify-deps-before-run=false --frozen-lockfile && corepack pnpm --config.verify-deps-before-run=false --dir artifacts/syncareer exec vite build --config vite.config.ts && rm -rf dist && cp -r artifacts/syncareer/dist/public dist
scripts.build:dev: corepack pnpm install --config.verify-deps-before-run=false --frozen-lockfile && corepack pnpm --config.verify-deps-before-run=false --dir artifacts/syncareer exec vite build --config vite.config.ts --mode development && rm -rf dist && cp -r artifacts/syncareer/dist/public dist
scripts.test: corepack pnpm install --config.verify-deps-before-run=false --frozen-lockfile && corepack pnpm --config.verify-deps-before-run=false --dir artifacts/syncareer exec vitest run
scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm install --config.verify-deps-before-run=false --frozen-lockfile && corepack pnpm --config.verify-deps-before-run=false --dir artifacts/syncareer exec tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.dev: corepack pnpm install --config.verify-deps-before-run=false --frozen-lockfile && corepack pnpm --config.verify-deps-before-run=false --dir artifacts/syncareer exec vite --config vite.config.ts --host 0.0.0.0
